text: {"assertions":["A double counting bug was discovered in analytics/etl/rollup.sql on 2026-01-07 affecting payloads larger than approximately 2 megabytes.","The double counting issue manifested as totals in the daily rollup exceeding the values in the source table.","The root cause of the double counting was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at).","The fix involved adding a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) to the analytics/etl/rollup.sql file and backfilling data in batches.","The fix was implemented in PR #6790 on the branch fix/double-counting-1.","The double counting issue was reproduced by rerunning the daily rollup for an already-loaded day.","Resolving the double counting issue reclaimed 43 GB of blob storage."]}
